title: Ext source-change and site-sections cancellation
statement: For a scheme X, an O_X-module F [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], degree p and a module cohomology class x [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology], the fixed module-to-Ext comparison [new-module-cohomology-ext-resolution-naturality] at x equals the inverse of terminal-source Ext precomposition followed by siteSectionsObjIso applied to the common-resolution abelian-sections comparison at x. This computes only the Ext-to-sections half of the comparison: it makes no assertion about a supplied resolution I, the module-resolution comparison a, or the acyclic-resolution comparison c.

source.place: Tags 015E and 03FD; corresponding factor of the explicit comparison in ModuleCohomologyExtResolutionNaturality.

proof.text: Evaluate the composite of a module/section natural isomorphism a, the inverse site-section isomorphism b, and the Ext-source isomorphism c for arbitrary functors. The component function sends x to c.hom.app (b.inv.app (a.hom.app x)). Unfold the fixed module comparison and its generic constructor, together with the module-cohomology and Ext-valued cohomology types, and apply this component equation. The site inverse is siteSectionsObjIso.inv and the terminal component is precompAddEquiv.symm. This proves the formula without unfolding the resolutionSectionsNatIso component or using a supplied resolution. No positive-degree, nonempty-space or nonzero-coefficient hypothesis is used.

lean.statement: theorem ext_sections_factorization (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) (p : ℕ) (x : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p).obj F) : moduleCohomologyExtResolutionEquiv X F p x = (by letI : EnoughInjectives (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) := (RingedSpace.moduleSheaves_abelian_enoughInjectives X.toRingedSpace).2 let T := SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) let Γ := sheafToPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u} ⋙ (evaluation X.Opensᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (op ⊤) let G := RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace let V := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤))) AddCommGrpCat.{u} let d := siteSectionsObjIso (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) ⊤ (T.obj F) p exact (Abelian.Ext.precompAddEquiv (terminalSourceIso X) (T.obj F) p).symm (d.inv (((resolutionSectionsNatIso G V T Γ p (sectionHomologyIso X p) (fun M _ ↦ forgottenInjectiveAcyclic X M)).app F).hom x)))
